articles.title: NCUA Draft 2027-2028 Budget
articles.snippet: Notice — National Credit Union Administration — NCUA's draft "detailed business-type budget" is being made available for public review as required by federal statute. The proposed resources will finance the agency's annual operations and capital projects, both of which are necessary for the agency to accomplish its mission of enabling access to financial services by facilitating safe, sound, and resilient credit unions. Comment instructions are included in the SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION section.
